source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    !!!! GPU Sensor need to load related driver first under OS. !!!!
1. Send command: ipmitool sdr elist
Check sensor reading change when temperature increase or decrease.
2. Send command: ipmitool sensor list
Check sensor threshold(upper/lower warning/critical) match with the spec
3. Heat up the sensor until higher than the warning and critical threshold
Check SEL when sensor reach to threshold

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Temperature should have a normal change behavior.
2. All setting should be correct and match with spec.
3. SEL should have a correct log when sensor reach to each threshold.
4. System should have correct behavior, like shutdown or change fan speed, when reach to threshold.
5. All TEMP_GB_GPU1_M~TEMP_GB_GPU8_M should get pass result

original_test_intent: With the required accelerator driver active, exercise and independently verify the `_M` temperature channel associated with every GPU1 through GPU8 through approved warning and critical thresholds, including correct SEL/protection behavior and complete accelerator recovery.
original_method: The Master explicitly uses high-level IPMI SDR/sensor reads while an engineer controls heat. It does not define `_M`, require raw bytes, identify GPUs by stable hardware identity or specify whether the eight channels are exercised sequentially or together.
manual_activity: An engineer defines `_M` for the platform, maps every channel to a physical GPU and component, confirms supported telemetry, approves whether GPUs are exercised sequentially or concurrently within the chassis power/cooling envelope, and owns physical abort and recovery.
required_inputs: `_M` definition and GPU1_M through GPU8_M physical sensor/component and SDR map
per-GPU UUID, PCI BDF, serial/slot and topology identities; numeric driver indexes are evidence only, not stable keys
standard SDR visibility or documented Project-approved vendor read-only interface
validated driver, VBIOS/firmware, management telemetry and workload/fixture versions
per-sensor units, limits, hysteresis, SEL event data and expected fan/throttle/power/shutdown behavior
workload-to-sensor coupling, sequential/concurrent power budget, active-job exclusion, abort, cooldown and recovery
safety_requirements: Do not assume `_M` means memory or module, and do not choose a workload until its thermal coupling to the defined component is documented.
Do not identify targets solely by GPU index; bind every command and sample to UUID/BDF/physical slot and revalidate topology before execution.
Confirm the DUT is dedicated and no user jobs or processes occupy any target GPU before applying load.

Continuously monitor all GPU/component temperatures, power, clocks, throttle reasons, ECC, XID, PCIe/fabric links, fans, BMC and host; abort on overshoot, error escalation, link/device loss or power/cooling margin violation.
Preserve first per-GPU SEL, XID, ECC, AER and driver evidence; do not clear logs or auto-retry. Cool and verify all eight devices recover.
agent_execution_scope: After approval, enumerate UUID/BDF/slot/topology and bind each `_M` SDR to exactly one physical component/GPU.
Run only the approved component-coupled workload on the authorized device set or monitor engineer-operated thermal equipment, while collecting synchronized IPMI/SEL and vendor telemetry.
Produce eight independent rows for temperature, threshold assert/deassert, fan/throttle/power behavior, ECC/XID/link health, cooldown and recovery; a subset cannot satisfy the all-eight criterion.
Do not define `_M`, invent raw commands, rely on unstable indexes, disturb active jobs, apply physical heat, clear evidence, auto-retry or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve `_M` semantics, eight-GPU identity map, supported read path, stack, workload/fixture coupling, power/cooling envelope, event matrix and recovery.
Provide physical oversight and emergency abort during thermal transitions.
Assess per-GPU/ECC/link anomalies and issue eight device-level plus overall DUT verdicts.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It correctly refuses guessed raw bytes but incorrectly declares them necessary. The Master supplies standard SDR/sensor reads; Project must first test those, then approve an alternative only if visibility is absent.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Start with trusted high-level IPMI SDR/sensor and SEL collection, correlated to UUID-bound vendor telemetry; use a documented read-only vendor decoder only when Project evidence shows the standard path is insufficient.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The driver note, GPU1_M~GPU8_M range, high-level IPMI commands, dynamic threshold purpose, script and 5/10-minute values remain; no raw bytes or guessed workload are inserted.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Define `_M`, bind every channel to UUID/BDF/slot and component, validate the supported read path, apply a bounded sensor-coupled per-GPU plan, correlate SEL/protection, then cool and prove all accelerators recover.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact eight-GPU/baseboard population, `_M` sensor implementation, topology and power/cooling design.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record chassis/board, GPU UUID/BDF/serial, VBIOS/firmware, driver, BMC/SDR, telemetry tool and workload/fixture versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor `_M` sensor map, supported BMC telemetry, component thermal limits, event/protection and multi-GPU recovery SOP.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds stable identity, semantic and workload-coupling proof, per-GPU ECC/XID/link evidence and explicit eight-device completeness without replacing Master commands.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A generic workload, numeric GPU index, changing subset or single shared event cannot prove all eight `_M` channels.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: `_M` semantics, identity/read matrix, qualified load, per-GPU limits/events and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Concurrent eight-GPU loading can exceed chassis power or cooling; sequential loading may not reproduce shared fan/power behavior and must be declared as a coverage difference.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may choose sequential or concurrent loading and a vendor read interface, but must preserve the original eight-channel target, record actual population, method equivalence, shared-response coverage and every missing/unreachable sensor. Fewer installed GPUs require explicit N/A disposition, not implicit PASS.
expected_evidence: standard-command availability result or approved vendor read-interface/decoder contract
dedicated-DUT and no-active-process proof plus approved sequential/concurrent workload or fixture and power/cooling abort plan
timestamped eight-channel temperatures, GPU power/clocks/throttle/ECC/XID, fan and host state
decoded warning/critical SEL assert/deassert entries separately attributed to every applicable GPU
PCIe/fabric link health, cooldown, per-GPU deassertion/device recovery and engineer verdicts

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The unique Master row consistently identifies eight `_M` thermal channels and explicit high-level IPMI reads. `_M` semantics are a normal Project mapping input, while the raw-byte claim exists only in prior review advice and is rejected rather than treated as a Master-source conflict.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The eight-device target, dynamic operation and all-channel criteria are clear. `_M` meaning, stable identities, tool path, workload coupling and safe limits are supplyable Project inputs, so attended setup with automated collection is feasible rather than permanently blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps the no-invention safeguard but restores the Master high-level commands and adds stable identity plus full functional coverage.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Changes BLOCKED to REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION under ED-36 and rejects the inherited raw-interface premise.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Independently expands its UUID mapping into active-job checks, ECC/XID/fabric evidence, coupled-load validation and sequential-versus-concurrent coverage.

review_improvement: Makes every `_M` channel attributable to a physical accelerator and component, prevents GPU-index drift and partial-device coverage, and corrects the unsupported raw-tool restriction.
independent_technical_reasoning: The Master provides standard observation commands and an explicit eight-channel criterion. Project engineering must define what `_M` measures and how to heat it safely, but those are readiness inputs. Once mapped, UUID-bound workload control and evidence collection are automatable under attended thermal and chassis-power supervision.
